target.title: fix(telegram): time out incomplete Mini App auth bodies
target.body:
Mini App 认证接口 (`/__openclaw_tg_miniapp/auth`) 只有 4 KiB 大小限制，没有读取超时。未认证客户端可持续发送不完整 body，占用请求处理资源。

## 修复

将手动逐 chunk 读取 body 替换为统一的 `readRequestBodyWithLimit`，复用 `WEBHOOK_BODY_READ_DEFAULTS.preAuth.timeoutMs` 超时策略：
- 超时后由 SDK 层 abort 请求并抛出 `REQUEST_BODY_TIMEOUT` 错误
- 路由层捕获后返回 408 Request body timeout
- 与 payload-too-large (413) 分支对称

## Proof

Real vitest terminal transcript against exact commit head `75df44a44b`:

```
$ npx vitest run extensions/telegram/src/miniapp/routes.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 RUN  v4.1.10

 ✓ serves the page without resolving published URLs       94ms
 ✓ mints a control-ui bootstrap token for a valid owner     8ms
 ✓ rejects replayed init-data without minting again         2ms
 ✓ reserves validated init-data before minting              1ms
 ✓ rejects non-owner Mini App auth requests                 1ms
 ✓ rate-limits repeated auth requests by IP                 5ms
 ✓ times out incomplete Mini App auth request bodies        7ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  7 passed (7)
 Duration  10.39s
```

Key proof line: "times out incomplete Mini App auth request bodies" exercises the real production route handler with a Readable stream that never calls `read()`, asserts the handler settles with HTTP 408 and "Request body timeout" body, and verifies the connection is released rather than held open.
